content_sections.heading: GBPUAT Associate Professor Qualification
content_sections.text: Ph.D. in the concerned, allied or relevant discipline. Master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade. At least eight years of teaching or research experience in a position equivalent to Assistant Professor. At least seven publications in peer-reviewed, NAAS-rated or UGC-listed journals. A minimum research score of 75 under the prescribed assessment criteria. Recognized basic veterinary qualification included in Schedule I or II of the Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984. Registration with a State Veterinary Council or Veterinary Council of India. Ph.D. and Master's degree in the relevant discipline with at least 55% marks. At least eight years of eligible teaching or research experience. At least seven prescribed journal publications and a research score of 75. Ph.D. in the concerned, allied or relevant discipline. First class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level in the relevant branch. At least six research publications in SCI, UGC or AICTE-approved journals. At least eight years of teaching, research or industry experience. At least two years of experience must be after obtaining the Ph.D.

content_sections.heading: GBPUAT Assistant Professor Qualification
content_sections.text: Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the concerned, relevant or allied subject. NET conducted by UGC, ICAR or CSIR, or an equivalent accredited examination such as SLET or SET. Candidates holding an eligible Ph.D. may receive exemption from NET, SLET or SET under the applicable UGC regulations. B.V.Sc. and A.H. degree from a college recognized by the Veterinary Council of India. Registration with the State or Central Veterinary Council. Relevant Master's degree with at least 55% marks. NET, SLET or SET qualification, or an eligible Ph.D. exemption under the applicable rules. Candidates must possess BE, BTech or BS and ME, MTech or MS, or an Integrated MTech in the relevant branch, with first class or equivalent in at least one of the degrees. The detailed list of acceptable concerned, allied and relevant disciplines is provided in Annexure V of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Qualification Relaxation
content_sections.text: A relaxation of 5% at Bachelor's and Master's levels is available to eligible SC, ST, OBC Non-Creamy Layer and differently-abled candidates. The relaxation is based only on qualifying marks and does not include grace marks. Eligible Ph.D. holders who obtained their Master's degree before 19 September 1991 may receive relaxation from 55% to 50%.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid through a Demand Draft drawn in favour of Comptroller, G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar . The Demand Draft must be payable at any one of the following branches: State Bank of India, Branch Code 1133 Punjab National Bank, Branch Code 4446 UCO Bank, Branch Code 0678 The application fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one position must submit a separate application and fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: Reservation Conditions
content_sections.text: The advertised posts are backlog vacancies reserved for SC, ST and OBC candidates. Uttarakhand reservation benefits are available only to permanent residents of Uttarakhand. Horizontal reservation applies to eligible women, persons with disabilities, dependants of freedom fighters, ex-army personnel and orphans under Uttarakhand Government rules. Reserved-category candidates from other states will be considered under the unreserved category. Applicants claiming reservation must attach the applicable caste and Uttarakhand domicile certificates.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The university may use one or more of the following stages: Screening of applications Academic or research score assessment Written or qualifying examination Presentation Interview The scrutiny committee will assess the candidate's academic and research score. A merit list will be prepared using the verified academic and research score. Candidates may be shortlisted at ten times the number of candidates for the first vacancy and five times for every additional vacancy. Shortlisted candidates will attend an interview carrying a maximum of 20 marks. Final selection will be based on the marks obtained in the interview. The academic score will be used for shortlisting candidates for interview. Final selection will be based on interview performance. The university may also conduct a written examination, qualifying examination or presentation when required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPUAT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official GBPUAT website . Open the recruitment section and download Employment Notice No. A-32/2026. Download the prescribed application form for the relevant post. Use Annexure I and II when applying for Associate Professor. Use Annexure III and IV when applying for Assistant Professor. Complete every section of the application form. Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph. Prepare the category-wise Demand Draft for the application fee. Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates and supporting documents. Sign every page of the application, annexures and supporting documents. Place the completed application and enclosures in an envelope. Write the post name, serial number, discipline and college name on the envelope. Send the application through Speed Post or Registered Post so that it reaches the university by 21 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Applications submitted through email, fax or any other electronic mode will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Application Postal Address
content_sections.text: The envelope should be superscribed: “Application for the post of (Name of Post with Serial Number and Discipline) for (Name of the College)”

content_sections.text: Completed prescribed application form Recent self-attested passport-size photograph Demand Draft for the applicable application fee Proof of date of birth Degree certificates and mark sheets NET, SLET or SET certificate, where applicable Ph.D. certificate and supporting documents, where applicable Teaching, research or industry experience certificates Research publications and publication evidence Academic or research scorecard SC, ST or OBC certificate Uttarakhand domicile certificate for reservation benefits Veterinary Council registration certificate for veterinary posts No Objection Certificate for candidates already in service Other supporting documents relevant to the post

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 45 backlog teaching vacancies, including 28 Associate Professor posts and 17 Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach GBPUAT by 21 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Applications must be sent through Speed Post or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for an Associate Professor?
faq.answer: The Associate Professor post carries Academic Level 13A with an entry pay of Rs.1,31,400.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for an Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor post carries Academic Level 10 with an entry pay of Rs.57,700.

faq.question: Q6. What is the GBPUAT application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1,500 for OBC candidates and Rs.750 for SC and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Can an application be submitted by email?
faq.answer: No. Applications submitted through email, fax or any electronic mode will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application form and application fee must be submitted for every post.
